pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with moderately sharp pixel gradients at edges. Spatial area of patches is larger and more rectangular on the neck base, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometric shapes on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored topological network with high-frequency junction nodes. Pathways maintain relatively uniform pixel thickness across the mid-section, forming a reticulated web.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the upper neck, though partially obscured by image resolution limits.
